programs.name: Core Program
programs.goal: GYM PROGRAM GOAL The Elite Accelerator Core Program is designed to build a strong, stable, and resilient core that supports every movement on the pitch. Ratherthan focusing on traditional sit-ups or isolated ab work, this program emphasizes anti-rotation, deep core stability, and integrated lower-body control, which are essential for balance, speed, change of direction, and injury prevention in football. programs.name: SAQ Program
programs.goal: SAQ PROGRAM GOAL The Elite Accelerator SAQ Program is designed to develop speed, agility, and quickness in a waythat directlytransfers to football performance. This program focuses on improving foot speed, coordination, directional changes, deceleration, and explosive movement patterns that players rely on during games. Program Focuses Improve foot speed, coordination, and reaction time Develop efficient movement mechanics in all directions Enhance agility, balance, and body control Improve deceleration and controlled stopping ability Increase quickness in short, explosive movements

programs.name: Speed Kills 2.0
programs.goal: SPEED KILLS GOAL Speed Kills 2.0 is a complete football-specific speed development system built to make players faster, more explosive, and more dangerous in real game situations. This program does not just train straight-line sprinting. It develops first-step quickness, acceleration, max velocity, explosive power, multi-directional speed, and sprint endurance, giving players the abilityto win races, create separation, and recover defensively. Program Focuses Improve first-step quickness and explosive starts Increase acceleration and horizontal force production Develop elite plyometric ability

programs.name: 90 Day Ball Mastery Program
programs.goal: 90 DAY BALL MASTERY GOAL The 90-Day Ball Mastery Program is a progressive technical system designed to develop elite-level control overthe ball in every situation. Across 12 weeks, players systematically improve their dribbling, first touch, juggling, and passing through structured, high-quality repetitions that increase in difficulty overtime. Program Focuses Develop elite-level ball control through consistent, progressive training Improve first touch on the ground and out of the air Build confidence receiving and controlling aerial balls Enhance dribbling control in tight spaces and at speed

programs.name: Advanced Dribbling Program
programs.goal: ADVANCED DRIBBLING PROGRAM GOAL The Advanced Dribbling Program is designed to develop elite level control, speed, and decision making on the ball for serious players who want to dominate in tight spaces and at high speed. This program goes beyond basic ball mastery and focuses on reacting under pressure, manipulating the ball cleanly with both feet, changing direction explosively, and staying in control while processing information in real time. From chaos dribbling to decision based gates and contrast work, every session is built to sharpen the type of dribbling control a modern player needs

programs.name: Advanced First Touch Program
programs.goal: ADVANCED FIRST TOUCH PROGRAM GOAL The Advanced First Touch Program is designed to build elite control, reaction speed, and awareness through every first contact with the ball. This program goes beyond simple receiving and focuses on controlling the ball with purpose, adjusting to unpredictable cues, and preparing the next action at speed. From directional first touches and turning under pressure to juggling based coordination work, every session is built to sharpen a player’s ability to stay clean, composed, and efficient in real game situations. Technical.why: More touches on the ball — this is what makes you confident with it at your feet.

Physical.why: Drills to get you faster, quicker and harder to knock off the ball.

Finishing & Crossing.why: Shooting and crossing — the stuff that puts the ball in the net.

first_touch: Killing the ball dead so your next move is easy.
ball_mastery: Fast little touches so the ball feels glued to your foot.
juggling: Keep-ups. The fastest way to rack up touches.
dribbling: Running with the ball and beating defenders.
finishing: Putting the ball in the back of the net.
crossing: Balls into the box for a teammate to score.
weak_foot: Making your other foot just as good.
speed: Running faster over short and long distances.
agility: Sharp turns and fast feet to change direction.
power: Explosive strength for jumping and sprinting.
strength: Getting stronger so you can hold players off.
core: A strong middle keeps you balanced in a battle.
conditioning: Lasting the whole game without fading.
mobility: Getting loose so you do not get hurt.
